---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

@fig-runtime-rating plots each film's runtime against its IMDb rating.

::: {#7f465c53 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display}
![Runtime (minutes) against IMDb rating](runtime-rating_files/figure-html/fig-runtime-rating-output-1.png){#fig-runtime-rating width=589 height=429}
:::
:::


## Mean rating by decade

::: {#6c8da9ce .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
